goal: Wave 3 build: Standing user profile: store, builder, editor; Batched web_search with reference ids; Pure edit contract in mp-contracts (fields, limits, shared descriptor fingerprint); Deck build helper and skill text; Completion judge; Goal attention and console view; Declared egress catalogue, generated disclosure, CI check; Effective-policy panel NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. mp-w2w3 is merged into model-plane: session-core migrations up to 0104 are taken (0101 and 0103 by EP-14-S6 and EP-8-S6), EP-4-S5 holds 0105 and EP-12-S14 0106; new session-core migrations take their reserved round-B number or the next free at or above 0107, capability-core at or above 0036 (EP-5-S6 holds 0035). pytest and python-pptx are not installed: write Python tests for 'python -m unittest' and skip what needs python-pptx. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object.
